doc: The blocks family: adding the first container to a one-line software system gives it a block; a quoted argument is replaced in place; the !include directive is kept and never followed.

steps.doc: The software system gains ' {' and a closing brace indented like it; the container sits one indentation step deeper.
Only the quoted argument's text changes.
